input.description: Shipped offline fixtures: a fixture HOME with opencode / Claude Code / codex configs and two third-party skills, plus a fixture project with opencode.json and .mcp.json. Every credential in the fixtures is a fake, vendor-shaped placeholder.

limitations: m1 scope: only `scan` writes a manifest; report / scope / diff are roadmap stubs (m2 / m3) and exit with a notice.
Tool versions are not detected: collectors never execute scanned binaries.
codex config.toml is scanned line-based (regex), not TOML-parsed.
observed_egress is read from existing local logs only and filtered to known provider / declared hosts; no active network probing exists anywhere in the codebase.
content_surface is a static best-effort statement by tool kind, not measured traffic.
Optional local-LLM skill summarization (--llm via Ollama, qwen2.5-7b-instruct) is on the roadmap; it is not implemented in this release and was not verified.
